No masterclass

Nothing live between a free PDF and a £10,000 decision

A woman can take your Scorecard or the 9-Day Energy Quest and never spend an hour with you. Your talks prove what happens when a room hears you live. Online, that room doesn’t exist yet.

Open “book a chat”

Your diary is the filter

The route into Brilliance is a chat booking or the contact page, with no application first. Anyone can book, so your time goes to the curious as well as the ready.

A ladder with no push

Great products, nothing walking people up

The Scorecard and the 9-Day Energy Quest add women to The Joy Brief, but neither ends with a clear “here’s your next step”. The books, The Joy Rebellion and Joy in HD wait to be found instead of being offered at the right moment.

41k people follow you and you’ve built 15 free tools, five books and three paid programmes. For almost everyone who isn’t ready for £10,000 today, there is no live next step with you, and no way to see which of them would be.

Meet Ali

Hi, I’m Ali Mortimer

I’m an executive coach and mentor to high-achieving women, a Human Design expert and the founder of The Joy Rebellion. After loss, and years in a corporate world that didn’t value women equally, I rebuilt my work, my health and my relationships around one idea: joy is a strategy.

I’m the author of The Joy Series, host of The Joy Broadcast, and in 2026 I’ve spoken for Women in Estate Agency on International Women’s Day and at SmartWorks Leeds.

Ad creatives · Video scripts · Meta

Video ad scripts

Three talking-to-camera scripts, each around 30 to 45 seconds, in your own voice. Each ends with an on-screen “Educational content, not medical advice.”

Script 1 · “Joy isn’t fluffy”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“I say this on every stage I stand on: joy isn’t fluffy.”

Body

“Most brilliant women I know were taught that joy is the reward. Work hard, tick everything off, and then you get to enjoy it. I teach the opposite. Joy is the strategy. When you lead with it, decisions get clearer and the next chapter starts to make sense.”

CTA

“I’m running a free live masterclass called the Joy Strategy. Tap Sign up to save your seat. The replay is included.”

Shot: talking to camera with flowers in frame, on-screen text “Joy is the strategy”.

Script 2 · “Pivots and plot twists”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Some of the best chapters of my life started with a plot twist I didn’t choose.”

Body

“A pivot can feel like the end of the plan. In my work with women, it’s often the start of a life with more purpose. The difference is having a way to choose what comes next, instead of drifting back to what you know.”

CTA

“I’ll show you how in my free class, the Joy Strategy Masterclass. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: walking outdoors, cut to a simple “Pivot · Purpose · Plan” graphic in plum and blush.

Script 3 · “Your energy type”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Three things your Human Design can tell you about how you make decisions.”

Body

“One: your energy type, and why some days flow and others don’t. Two: your authority, how you know a yes is a real yes. Three: your strategy, the way opportunities tend to reach you. It’s not about labels. It’s about working with your energy.”

CTA

“Join my free live class. Sixty minutes, replay included. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, counting on fingers, numbers 1 to 3 on screen in blush.
